task_title: export된 binary/GDS 구조를 다시 import하여 독립 finer forward로 평가한다

seed.note: deterministic starts declared here; the same seeds are used for both examples

physics_configuration.metagrating: examples/design_metagrating.py as declared in cases/G6-05.json (1.5 um period, 0.5 um layer of epsilon 4 in air, 30 pixels of 0.05 um, filter radius 0.125 um, beta 4 doubled every 4 steps to 64, Adam 0.1), coarse mesh 0.05 um and 800 steps, 24 iterations; final evaluation at 0.025 um and 1600 steps with a fresh DifferentiablePlaneSimulation and its own background reference
physics_configuration.coupler: examples/design_mode_coupler.py as declared in cases/G6-05.json (two 0.6 um guides of epsilon 4 in 2.25 offset by 0.6 um, 6 x 10 pixels of 0.2 um, rotate180 symmetry, filter radius 0.4 um, beta 4 doubled every 4 steps to 64, Adam 0.1), coarse mesh 0.2 um and 500 steps, 16 iterations; final evaluation at 0.1 um and 1000 steps with fresh ModeNetworks at 1.55 um (objective) and 1.50 um (holdout)
physics_configuration.stages: coarse_smooth (last coarse evaluation of the continuous density), fine_smooth (continuous density through the density transfer at the fine mesh), fine_binary (density thresholded at 0.5, same transfer), fine_structures (binary_structures rectangles written to JSON, re-read by Structure.model_validate, staircase voxelized), fine_gds (the same rectangles written by export_gds at 1 nm precision, re-read by import_gds as polygons, staircase voxelized)
physics_configuration.differences: mesh_refinement = fine_smooth - coarse_smooth, thresholding = fine_binary - fine_smooth, smoothing = fine_structures - fine_binary, gds = fine_gds - fine_structures, total = fine_gds - coarse_smooth, per metric
physics_configuration.starts: seeds 1, 2 and 3 for each example; torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed) draws the initial logits; every start is run, recorded under docs/validation/g6/<example>-seed<n>.json and judged; no start is selected or dropped

reference_method: Independent forward of the same solver at half the mesh and twice the steps, built from the declared physical configuration rather than the objective's model (convergence_study), applied to the exported geometry read back through the public structure and GDS paths. The pre-declared thresholds below were fixed after pilot runs at this commit and before the recorded runs; per-step monotonicity of the optimizer is not required and not asserted.

observables.name: final_objective
observables.definition: metagrating: +1 transmitted efficiency at 1.0 um of the fine_gds stage; coupler: |S21|^2 at 1.55 um of the fine_gds stage

observables.name: holdout
observables.definition: metagrating: +1 transmitted efficiency at 0.95 um of the fine_gds stage (recorded from the same run, never optimized); coupler: |S21|^2 at 1.50 um of the fine GDS design through a second network (never optimized)

observables.name: stage_differences
observables.definition: the four consecutive differences and the total, per start, reported not judged

observables.name: feature_sizes_and_violations
observables.definition: measured minimum linewidth and gap of the thresholded design against the declared 2-pixel limits, per start, reported not judged

observables.name: perturbation_objective_change
observables.definition: coarse objective change under a one-pixel erosion and dilation, per start, reported not judged

acceptance_limits.rule: every declared start must reach both thresholds at the fine GDS stage; the test reports all starts and fails on any start below either threshold
acceptance_limits.context: pilots at this commit with the declared settings: metagrating (24 iterations, filter 0.125 um) fine GDS efficiency 0.498, 0.519, 0.468 and holdout 0.592, 0.276, 0.473 for seeds 1, 2, 3; coupler (16 iterations, filter 0.4 um) fine GDS transmission 0.614, 0.576, 0.576 and holdout 0.578, 0.556, 0.556, against 0.34 for an empty design box at the coarse mesh. Earlier pilots with narrower filters: metagrating (16 iterations, filter 0.075 um) 0.498, 0.480, 0.462 with holdout 0.592, 0.238, 0.556; (24 iterations, filter 0.075 um) 0.594, 0.365, 0.495 with holdout 0.570, 0.389, 0.557; coupler (12 iterations, filter 0.3 um, seed 1) 0.608 with holdout 0.580. An unpatterned metagrating layer has zero +1 efficiency by symmetry
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: fixture-specific budgets declared before the recorded runs from the pilots above with margin for the sensitivity of one- and two-pixel features to the mesh; no program threshold applies to a design objective

applicable_scope: G6-07 export and re-import: CPU float32, three declared starts per example judged at half the coarse mesh with the same solver; the finer forward is a refinement of the same discretization, not an independent solver; the exported rectangles are pixel aligned so the GDS polygon path is exact by construction re-recorded on 6d03e49d91d4 for the release candidate.
